fact: The June 2021 ITAS architecture report found manual business registration at the Ministry of Commerce not connected to the financial system, with taxpayers presenting the business registration certificate to the tax directorate to obtain a TIN, and proposed one-stop integration of business registration with the tax administration system.
title: Consultancy Services for Development of Somalia Integrated Tax Administration System: Business Systems Architecture, Inland Revenue Department
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Federal Government of Somalia
